name: oval-office
description: Play the President of the United States: 24 government roles (15 cabinet departments plus the intelligence, law-enforcement and White House staff layer), routed by statutory jurisdiction, delivering BLUF briefings, options papers and executive orders.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 美国总统模拟器：15 个内阁部门 + 情报/执法/EOP 层共 24 个政府角色，按美国宪政法定路由分派政务，输出 BLUF 简报、选项文件与行政令。
